text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Formation of a new Shura Council will be declared next week. The Emir, Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa, last week issued a decree increasing Shura Council members to 40 from 30.
- High-level delegation from the finance, economy and commerce ministries is expected to represent Bahrain at the Middle East-North Africa economic summit in Egypt.
